name: Camera IP Hikvision DS-2CD6365G0E-I(V)(S)
summary: 360° 0-blind zone image, a fisheye network camera capable of providing a 360 degree panoramic image of its surveillance scene Multi dewarping modes, the image can be dewarped to normal image to view intuitively Built-in mic and speaker, it supports two-way audio to realize real-time security by hearing sound and speaking through the camera IP66/IK10 , water resistant and vandal proof, there is no need to worry about water ingress when it is used in outdoor scenarios
